quests.title: Short Delivery, Yallamundi
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The Yallamundi order has been two cartons light every week since grand final week and the invoice says otherwise every time. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Yallamundi
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $166 owing to Yallamundi and it is not going to walk in here itself. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: $166, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Yallamundi Run
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I do the Yallamundi run at just gone midnight and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Dundas
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Yallamundi
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. I have got a bucket of odd keys in the back of the van and the Yallamundi shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Yallamundi
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Three of the Yallamundi regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $93 down on those days. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$93, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Yallamundi
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Everything Yallamundi sells comes off a floor at Rosehill Gardens, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. I am aware how that sounds. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Wombarra
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Wombarra on the week of the show and one of them has a note from his mother. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Wombarra
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. We found a twelfth, which means the Wombarra club now owes the association $40 it had budgeted on not owing. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: $40 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Wombarra Canteen
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. The canteen at Wombarra does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at the middle of the news. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Wombarra
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Somebody walked off with the float from the Wombarra canteen at about the middle of the news during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$12, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Wombarra
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The sprinkler line under the Wombarra outfield has been leaking since the week of the show and the wet patch has started to move. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Wombarra
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Coledale, and Wombarra has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. I am aware how that sounds. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Vineyard
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Vineyard since school holidays and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Vineyard
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. They have agreed to a clean-up at Vineyard, which is wonderful, except the grant is $37 short and closes on school holidays. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: $37, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Vineyard
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. We had 71 sandbags in the Vineyard shed on school holidays and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Vineyard
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. People keep driving the low crossing at Vineyard at five in the morning with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Vineyard
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The water came through my place at Vineyard on school holidays and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, Vineyard
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Whatever is happening to Vineyard starts upstream at Mulgrave, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. I am aware how that sounds. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
